title: go.mod module manifest served
description: The response is a Go module manifest: the module path and its requirement block. It names the internal module path of the project, which is often the repository host, and pins every dependency version.
remediation: Exclude module manifests from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.
limitation: One response body. The rule reads the module declaration; it does not resolve the dependency versions.

observation.body:
module git.internal/shop/api

go 1.22

require (
	github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1
)

module github.com/shop/service

go 1.21

require github.com/lib/pq v1.10.9

replace github.com/shop/core => ../core
Declare the module path at the top of go.mod.
